lawyer: Mr. Akhtar Imam, Advocate ------ For the Petitioner.
parties:
Social Marketing Company ------ Petitioner.
Vs.
Mr. Mahbubuzzaman, Chairman, Social Marketing Company ------ Opposite Party.
full_judgment: A. M. Mahmudur Rahman, J.: This application under Section 76(3) read with Section 79(3) of the Companies Act, 1913 at the instance of the petitioner, the Chairman of the Company is for condonation of delay in holding the Annual General Meeting of the Company which was held on 26.12.1991 beyond the statutory period of limitation and to accord approval to such meeting ex-post facto declaring the meeting held beyond the statutory period as valid. The petitioner Company is a limited company and is engaged in non-profitable business and its members do not receive any profit arising out of its business as non-profitable Company under Section 26 of the Companies Act, 1913. It is stated that 2nd Annual General Meeting of the Company was to be held on 13th September 1991 but the same was held on 26. 12. 1991. It is stated that the 3rd Annual General Meeting of the Company was held duly on December 17, 1992, and at the time of filing return of the 3rd Annual General Meeting and extraordinary General Meeting, which was held on December 17, 1992, it came to the knowledge of the Company that the second Annual General Meeting was inadvertently held beyond the statutory period, it was to be held on or before September 13, 1991. It is stated that there was no negligence on the part of any member of the Company. Hence this application for granting order of validity of the said meeting ex-post facto approving the same.
